commander.style: Calm, steady tactical squad leader in freezing arctic wind, low radio grit, crisp authority under fire.

engineer.style: Focused field engineer, tired and freezing, practical brisk cadence with quiet determination.

medic_sapper.style: Alert tactical medic and sapper, controlled urgency in bitter cold, clear sharp articulation.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Urgent, controlled, crisp warning callout on sight of hostiles.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Commanding, urgent tactical order under sudden threat.
lines.text: Ambush! Hostiles on the level - eliminate them!

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Firm tactical warning over cold wind, bracing the squad.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Autonomy ON. Operatives hold positions within 7 m of the order point.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.style: Relieved, gritty determination as machinery finally turns over.
lines.text: Pouring in the diesel and pulling the starter... The generator roars to life!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Relieved, breathless triumph in freezing air.
lines.text: Generator restored! All turrets are powered!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Matter-of-fact field report, tired and steady.
lines.text: Surviving fortifications dismantled and returned to the gear.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Dry observation after inspecting broken equipment in subzero cold.
lines.text: The backup generator is intact, but the tank is dry. It needs diesel fuel.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.style: Focused effort turning into quiet satisfaction.
lines.text: Draining the remaining diesel from the APC fuel system... canister is full!

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: Found an empty 20L Fuel Canister. Now we have something to drain the fuel into.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Sharp, urgent warning, sudden stop signal to teammates.
lines.text: Tripwire! Wire at shin height - everyone hold position!

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Calm analytical report while checking an abandoned vehicle.
lines.text: The abandoned vehicle's tank still holds diesel, but there is nothing to drain it into.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Clipped, tense combat callout over gunfire.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: High urgency tactical shout warning allies to take cover.

lines.speaker: medic_sapper
lines.style: Controlled, low breath in cover, scanning the sector.
